condition: np.unwrap applies the corrections with a floating-point cumsum, so rounding errors build up and values near the end of large arrays, or of float32 arrays, end up with large phase errors.
workaround: Normalize to units of the period so the corrections are integers: np.unwrap(x / tau, period=1.0) * tau. Alternatively, compute integer period counts, run cumsum on those, and subtract counts * period.
